insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput. This allows attaching multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This field can be used to provide multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, improving the accuracy of order tracking. The GraphQL Admin API will need to be updated to include this new field in the OrderCreateFulfillmentInput type.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will have more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, improving the overall customer experience.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the flexibility and accuracy of order tracking, allowing merchants to provide better customer service and improving the overall customer experience.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.4
updates.summary: Hydrogen CLI now supports a new flag --javascript-origin to override the default --dev-origin for customer account push. Local Hydrogen CLI discovery has also been fixed.

updates.title: @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.2
updates.summary: MiniOxygen now supports HTTP/2 requests in Vite request conversion, enhancing performance.

updates.title: @shopify/hydrogen@2026.4.5
updates.summary: Hydrogen customer account login recovery has been improved when switching browser contexts or opening multiple login tabs, with OAuth state values now using cryptographically secure randomness.

updates.title: skeleton@2026.4.6
updates.summary: Newly scaffolded storefronts now recommend the Shopify AI Toolkit, and dependencies have been updated.

updates.title: @shopify/create-hydrogen@5.0.39
updates.summary: The create-hydrogen package now recommends the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants.
The CLI now serves UI extension source maps during app development, enhancing debugging capabilities.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, with the updateCart action updating cart attributes and a new event firing when attributes are updated.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being moved from reserved to committed, consolidating in-progress inventory holds.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing deployment of Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, enhancing order import capabilities.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and new ShopifyQL schema for Shop Campaigns performance data

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple Hydrogen-related packages received updates, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen. These updates include new flags, improved HTTP/2 support, and enhanced security features. The skeleton package also received an update, recommending the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

themes.title: ShopifyQL and Analytics
themes.detail: The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query Shop Campaigns performance data on behalf of authorized merchants.
